nights.title: Merve Özbey
nights.name: Merve Özbey
nights.extract: Merve Özbey is a Turkish singer and songwriter. Due to her collaborations with Erdem Kınay in the songs "Duman" and "Helal Ettim", she became famous in Turkey.

en.who: Merve Özbey is a Turkish singer and songwriter. Her collaborations with Erdem Kınay on the songs "Duman" and "Helal Ettim" made her famous in Turkey.
